mode_1_cloud_edge_hybrid.description: Edge diagnostic core (L2 + L3 PubMedBERT + L4) runs locally on CPU (<90 ms, <600 MB RAM). Conversational dialogue (L1 & L5) offloaded to cloud/server Qwen 2.5 7B endpoint.

mode_2_autonomous_rural_phc_offline.description: Zero-internet rural clinic fallback. Layer 1 uses heuristic entity extraction, Layer 3 uses Calibrated Logistic Regression, Layer 5 uses template generation. Runs entirely on CPU (<2 ms, <100 MB RAM).
